servo.heading: Servo System Solution

hero.title: Easy PC-based position control with INOVANCE servos
hero.lead: Control multiple INOVANCE servo axes from your PC over Ethernet, without a separate motion controller or command wiring.
hero.alt: INOVANCE servo drives and servo motor

connection.title: Ethernet motion control with INOVANCE servos
connection.intro: Mount Ezi-MOTIONLINK Plus-E on SV660, SV670 or SV680 servo drives to control up to 254 axes from a PC over an Ethernet daisy chain. A built-in Ethernet switch supports the connection, motion settings are stored as parameters, and a motion library (DLL) is provided for PC programming.
connection.network: Ethernet daisy chain · Up to 254 axes

points.title: Key benefits
points.intro: Keep INOVANCE servo performance and simplify host control with a PC and Ethernet.
points.axisBody: Build a daisy chain with the integrated dual-port switch. Set the IP address easily using the rotary switch.
points.easyBody: Mount directly on the INOVANCE servo drive for quick installation without separate command wiring.
points.guiBody: Use the dedicated GUI for parameter settings, jog, homing, repeat tests and command tables. Integrate directly into PC programs with the DLL.

set.title: Recommended set
set.intro: Purchase the components as a set to implement position control easily.

dimensions.title: Controller dimensions
dimensions.intro: A compact module mounted on the front of the drive.

rows.label: Input signals
